description: This file implements kernel functions related to dispatching in PyTorch, including fallthrough, ambiguity, and not supported kernels, as well as state dumping and equality checks for KernelFunction objects.

classes.name: KernelFunction
classes.description: Represents a kernel function with methods for dumping state and comparing kernel functions.

methods.name: fallthrough_kernel
methods.description: A special kernel that redispatches to the next dispatch key, used as a placeholder in dispatch tables.

methods.name: ambiguous_autogradother_kernel
methods.description: Kernel that asserts if registered to both CompositeImplicitAutograd and AutogradOther, indicating an ambiguity.

methods.name: named_not_supported_kernel
methods.description: Kernel that raises an error if called with named tensors, indicating unsupported operation.

methods.name: KernelFunction::dumpState
methods.description: Returns a string describing the state of the kernel function (e.g., fallthrough, boxed, unboxed).

methods.name: KernelFunction::_equalsBoxedAndUnboxed
methods.description: Checks if two KernelFunction objects have the same boxed and unboxed function pointers.
